beats.say: 34 minutes: the Super Bowl was once stopped by a partial power outage.
That is long enough to watch four whole YouTube Shorts and still have time for a snack.
The Baltimore Ravens were dominating the San Francisco 49ers in the first half of the game.
Jacoby Jones then returned the second half kickoff for a record 108 yards to make it 28 to 6.
Suddenly, the lights in the Mercedes-Benz Superdome flickered and died, suspending the biggest game on earth.
After play resumed, the 49ers rallied to close the gap to 28 to 23 as the momentum shifted.
The Ravens eventually held on to win 34 to 31 in one of the strangest finals ever played.
